about: A static site generator that turns Markdown into a blog.

prs.title: Draft posts stay out of the sitemap
prs.broken: Draft posts, the drafts page and draft feeds that did not exist were listed in the sitemap, so search engines found drafts and broken links.
prs.changed: The sitemap now leaves out drafts and everything that lists them.
prs.matters: Unpublished posts stay hidden, as the docs promise.

prs.title: Draft posts stay out of series pages
prs.broken: A draft post in a series showed up on the public series page, and published parts linked to it as the next part.
prs.changed: Series pages and next and previous links now leave drafts out, as tag and archive pages already did.
prs.matters: Unfinished posts stay private until you publish them.
